description: Canonical block fee allocations, shielded activity and sampled NSM/supply history.
note: All Zat amounts are exact decimal strings or null. Bounded to 120 blocks by default, at most 1000; before is an exclusive height cursor. Fee removal is floor(aggregate block fees * 3 / 5) per active block, never rounded after aggregation. Reserves, supply, pools and subsidy use retained hash-matched node observations; missed/pre-collection tips remain null. NSM net change requires consecutive observations and is neither gross removals nor reissuance. Orphan observations are retained but excluded by a canonical height/hash join. Reissuance remains unavailable. Requires database migration 027 and the accounting observer. Optional period=1d|7d|30d|all selects NU7-only UTC block-header aggregation instead of block pagination; all means since activation. Returns at most approximately 241 time buckets, exact selected-period and since-activation fee totals (per-block rounding first), cumulative minimum removal, and net reserve growth from the preactivation hash-matched sample. Cannot combine period with limit/before. Missing fee/indexed ranges make affected totals and cumulative values null; missing bucket-end reserve samples stay null. Reserve growth is not cumulative fees. Responses are cached internally for at most 60 seconds and canonical anchors revalidated on every read.

description: Observed chain supply and estimated daily subsidy.
note: Supply history defaults to all available history, preserving decreases and remaining gaps. Permanent chain_supply_daily records reconstruct completed UTC header-day boundaries from canonical node getblock chain supply; the shared serving-node ancestry checkpoint is checked by height/hash on each read. The database supplies calendar/height hints; node-canonical blocks override stale indexed fork hints. Idle days retain the actual unchanged chain state. Recent chain_snapshots provide newer observations. Legacy privacy trends are a fallback when snapshots are sparse and the permanent archive is absent. circulatingZat and emissionZat are integer zatoshis; ZEC values are display conversions. Invalid or missing supply (including legacy zero sentinels) is null. supplyHistoryTable and supplyObservedAt identify the selected stored source and its latest timestamp; stored history is not live supply. The legacy dailyEmission array is signed net chain-supply change, not gross issuance; missing or nonconsecutive days have null changes. dailyEmissionEstimate extrapolates the current node subsidy at the observed recent block cadence and is null when those inputs are unavailable. Complete cadence windows may end up to 12 indexed blocks behind the node; cadence.lagBlocks and endHeight disclose this lag, and larger backlogs remain unavailable. Optional projection starts at a height-tagged supply snapshot and adds exact scheduled subsidies using the node activation schedule; future removals and NSM reissuance are excluded. Projection dates extrapolate observed cadence across scheduled target-spacing eras, or use consensus target spacing when measured cadence is unavailable; dateBasis identifies the basis. Missing baseline or schedule yields null projection.

description: Broadcast a fully-signed raw transaction (no keys involved).
note: Core public write endpoint. See README caveats re: proxy write semantics (no v1-layer idempotency key yet — a client retry on timeout may double-submit; legacy sendrawtransaction is itself idempotent at the mempool level for an unchanged tx, so a duplicate submit is harmless, but a network partition on the internal hop can still return a spurious error for a tx that actually broadcast).

rawTx.description: Already signed serialized transaction. No private key is accepted.

description: Batch-scan a height range for Orchard transactions (wallet scanning aid).
note: v1 enforces a stricter max range (default 50,000 blocks vs. legacy's 1,000,000, see V1_SCAN_ORCHARD_MAX_RANGE) and a per-IP rate limit (default 5/minute, see V1_SCAN_ORCHARD_RATE_LIMIT_MAX/_WINDOW_MS) before proxying to the legacy endpoint.

requestBody.description: Inclusive block range. Maximum 10,000 blocks for lightwalletd or 50,000 for Orchard by default; configured server limits may differ.

description: Batch-scan blocks via Lightwalletd gRPC for client-side trial decryption.
note: v1 requires an explicit `endHeight` (legacy defaults a missing one to the current chain tip, which v1 treats as an unbounded-until-resolved request shape and rejects), enforces a stricter max range (default 10,000 blocks vs. legacy's 50,000, see V1_SCAN_LIGHTWALLETD_MAX_RANGE — lightwalletd scanning is more expensive per block: gRPC + parallel streaming + optional disk cache writes), and a per-IP rate limit (default 3/minute, see V1_SCAN_LIGHTWALLETD_RATE_LIMIT_MAX/_WINDOW_MS) before proxying.

requestBody.description: Inclusive block range. Maximum 10,000 blocks for lightwalletd or 50,000 for Orchard by default; configured server limits may differ.
